preconditions.description: The lengths of both input bracket sequences s and t are at most 200.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in s) and all(c in '()' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both input sequences s and t consist only of the characters '(' and ')'.

postconditions.description: The output string is a regular bracket sequence.
The output string contains both s and t as subsequences.
The output string has the minimum possible length among all regular bracket sequences that contain both s and t as subsequences.
